title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ojt7: Vec<bool> passed to Ack::new() which expects u64 bitmap
description:
In rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs (std_ext module, lines 1174, 1190, 1217):
window_bitmap() returns Vec<bool> but Ack::new() expects a u64 bitmap.
The bitmap gets passed as &bitmap (&Vec<bool>) which doesn't match u64.

Fix: either convert Vec<bool> to u64 bitmask, or update Ack::new() to accept Vec<bool>, or change window_bitmap() to return u64 directly.
